title: ngGirls @ Warsaw (AI edition)
announcement: We are excited to announce ngGirls workshop in Warsaw on January 17, 2027!
This free, one-day workshop is designed to introduce women to the world of web development with Angular and the magic of AI ✨.
Whether you're a complete beginner or have some coding experience, this workshop will help you build your first Angular application in a friendly and supportive environment.
ngGirls @ Warsaw (AI edition) 2027 will take place on Sunday, January 17, 2027 from 10:00-17:00 at Darize office in Warsaw.
details: Together, we will build a little 🧸 Review Buddy while exploring modern web development with and without AI.
🅰️ Angular Fundamentals: Component architecture, forms and application structure.
🛠️ Essential Developer Skills: Code reviews, coding patterns, research, continuous learning and documentation.
🤖 Introduction to AI: Get an overview of AI tools, their setup and common buzzwords.
⚖️ Opportunities & Challenges of AI: Explore security, tokens, agentic engineering and hallucinations.
🚀 AI-enhanced Coding with MCP: Discover how the Angular MCP Server can support your development workflow.
note: The event has been postponed from its original date as part of ngGirls @ NG Poland 2026.
